## Theme

No in-person class meetings during finals week. The Strategic
Translation Portfolio is submitted via GitHub (link posted to Carmen) by
Friday April 30 at 11:59 PM. The instructor will hold virtual office
hours Monday April 28 and Tuesday April 29 for final questions.

**Assignment Final Check-In:** Final Portfolio is due tonight at 11:59
PM. Your GitHub repository must contain: (1) 3 curated lab .Rmd files
and their knitted HTML outputs, each with a 150-word framing note in the
README; (2) a new 3-page policy memo in the policy-memo/ folder; (3) a
400-word self-reflection in the reflection/ folder; (4) a completed
README.md. Graduate students: your literature synthesis must be in the
repository. Submit your GitHub link --- not the files themselves --- via
the Carmen assignment portal.

## Classroom Lab Demonstration

**Legal Focus:** No new legal content this week. Review: which of the 4
assignments engaged most directly with a specific legal doctrine? Write
a sentence in your reflection connecting your data work to a specific
law, statute, or regulation.

**Health Focus:** No new health content this week. Ensure your final
policy memo identifies the specific health outcome your evidence
addresses, names the affected population, and cites the geographic scope
of the problem.

**Data:** Final GitHub repository review: all datasets should be
documented in the README with source URLs; no raw data files over 50MB
should be committed to GitHub (use .gitignore or link to external source
instead).

**R Code:** Final reproducibility check: restart R, clear environment,
run each lab file start to finish. All packages should load without
errors. If a package is not on CRAN, include installation instructions
in the README.

- Final review of GitHub repository for completeness and reproducibility

- Confirm all three curated labs knit without errors in a completely
  fresh R session

- Final polish on new 3-page synthesis policy memo and 400-word
  self-reflection

- Submit GitHub repository link via Carmen by Friday April 30 at 11:59
  PM
